blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.
blocks.zh: 虽然现代视频基因模型实现了显著的视觉忠实,但在产生物理上可信的动态和复杂的相互作用时,这些模型仍然明显脆弱。 有针对性的培训后培训至关重要,但受监督的微调却受到离线状态不匹配的影响,强化学习因缺乏定义的物理奖励功能而受阻。 政策(自我)分裂(OPSD)使政策推出与密集的纠正反馈相协调,将核心挑战转向设计有效的特权环境。 然而,传统模式还很短:文本提示本身就具有宣示性,而真实的参考视频则在视觉外观上严重缠绕了物理定律,没有参数控制. 为此,我们提出PhysOPSD,引入可执行代码作为视频生成的特权物理上下文. 与静态视觉观测不同,可执行代码即时将一个具有内在抽象和可控性的可编辑物理世界. 由PhysOPSD-Engine提供动力,我们把现实世界的物理情景转化为可核查的模拟程序. PhysOPSD随后纳入了(一)通过中间瓶颈来弥补信息差距的双重物理特权,以及(二)在共享推出噪声下受控的物理变化,以暴露因果动态变化. 广泛的实验表明,物理学OPSD大大改进了不同骨干之间的物理可信度,超过了SFT和RL基线,只有$K样本,同时保持了一般的视频生成质量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent video generation models [ 40 , 10 , 15 , 1 ] have made impressive strides in visual fidelity and temporal coherence, yet they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions [ 28 , 2 , 3 ] . Targeted post-training has thus emerged as a vital route to reinforce physical capabilities beyond pre-training [ 18 , 32 ] . However, existing paradigms involve clear trade-offs: ➀ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) offers dense supervision [ 42 , 29 , 17 , 49 ] , but operates on offline data that mismatches the states visited during inference; ➁ reinforcement learning (RL) optimizes directly over on-policy rollouts [ 14 , 8 , 12 ] , yet suffers from sparse, ill-defined rewards and credit-assignment bottlenecks.
blocks.zh: 近期的视频生成模型[40、10、15、1]在视觉忠实性和时间一致性方面取得了令人印象深刻的进展,但当产生物理上可信的动态和复杂的互动时,这些模型仍然明显脆弱[28、2、3]。 因此,有针对性的后培训已成为在培训前加强体能的重要途径[18、32]。 然而,现有的模式涉及明确的取舍:QQ监督微调(SFT)提供密集的监督[42,29,17,49],但操作的离线数据与推断期间访问的州不匹配;QQ强化学习(RL)直接优化了政策推出[14,8,12],然而却受到很少,定义不明确的奖励和信用分配瓶颈的影响.

blocks.en: Recent ➂ on-policy distillation (OPD) [ 22 , 34 ] provides a natural middle ground by querying a teacher for dense supervision on student-visited rollout states. Building upon this, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) [ 50 ] further removes the need for an external teacher by casting the same model into asymmetric roles: the student acts on inference-time inputs, while the teacher accesses additional privileged context to supervise the student rollouts. The central question of OPSD therefore becomes how to leverage extra information to turn the same model into a stronger self-teacher , as shown in Figure 2 ( a ). An effective privileged context should directly expose the information required by the target capability and reliably enhance teacher predictions on student rollout states. This principle has shown strong promise in language reasoning via ground-truth answers and rationales [ 50 , 31 , 47 ] , as well as in image generation via target-image multimodal representations [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 近期的QQ政策蒸馏(OPD)[22,34]提供了一个自然的中间点,通过询问一位教师对学生访问的推出州进行密集的监督. 在此基础上,政策上的自我消化(OPSD)[50]进一步消除了对外部教师的需求,将同样的模式铸成不对称的角色:学生根据推论时间的投入行事,而教师则获得额外的特权背景来监督学生的推出. 因此,OPSD的中心问题是如何利用额外信息将同一模式转变为更强大的自我教师,如图2(a)所示。 有效的特权环境应直接暴露目标能力所要求的信息,并可靠地增强教师对学生推出状态的预测。 这一原则在通过地面真实的答案和理由[50、31、47]进行语言推理方面,以及在通过目标图像的多式联运表述生成图像方面,都表现出了强烈的希望。

blocks.en:
Extending this paradigm to video generation, however, is far less straightforward, as the primary bottleneck lies in modeling physically plausible dynamics, a capability that also defies evaluation by standard reward models [ 18 , 42 , 3 ] .
Yet, designing effective privileged context remains non-trivial: text expansion provides richer descriptions but remains fundamentally declarative, whereas real reference videos capture complete dynamics but heavily entangle them with irrelevant appearance, identity, and background clutter without controllable structure ( Figure 2 ( b )).
These bottlenecks lead to our core research question:
blocks.zh:
然而,将这种模式推广到视频制作方面,就不那么直截了当了,因为主要的瓶颈在于模拟实际可行的动态,这种能力也不利于标准奖励模式的评价[18、42、3]。
然而,设计有效的特权背景仍然是非三角性的:文本扩展提供了更丰富的描述,但基本上仍然是宣示性的,而真实的参考视频则捕捉到完整的动态,但大量将它们与无关的外观、身份和背景纠缠在一起,没有可控制的结构(图2(b))。
这些瓶颈导致我们的核心研究问题:

blocks.en: Research Question How can we construct privileged context that unlocks a video generator as its own physics teacher?
blocks.zh: 研究问题 如何构建特权背景 解锁视频生成器 作为自己的物理老师?

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we introduce PhysOPSD , which proposes executable code as privileged physical context for video generation OPSD. Our key insight is that an executable physical scene instantiates an editable world rather than a fixed visual outcome.
This executability inherently provides two structural properties absent in raw video data: ❶ abstraction , the ability to express dynamics across varying information densities; and ❷ controllability , the ability to isolate and systematically perturb underlying physical parameters. To operationalize this insight, we first develop PhysOPSD-Engine , which converts diverse real-world scenarios into verifiable simulation code and renders synchronized physical drafts via a coding agent.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们引入了PhysOPSD,其中提出了可执行代码作为视频生成OPSD的特权物理上下文. 我们的关键洞察力是,一个可执行的物理场景会瞬间产生一个可编辑的世界,而不是固定的视觉结果.
这种可执行性在本质上提供了原始视频数据中缺失的两个结构属性: QQ抽象,表达不同信息密度的动态的能力; QQ可控性,隔离和系统扰动基础物理参数的能力. 为了实现这一洞察力,我们首先开发了PhysOPSD-Engine(英语:PhysOPSD-Engine),它将各种现实世界的情景转换为可核查的模拟代码,并通过编码剂使物理草稿同步.

( a ) OPSD shifts physical post-training from reward engineering to privileged context design; ( b ) Executable code explicitly parameterizes physical processes, uniquely unlocking abstraction and controllability ; ( c ) Using executable code as privileged context , PhysOPSD internalizes physical dynamics into the student for simulation-free video generation.

blocks.en:
PhysOPSD then systematically translates these two properties into OPSD:
♣ dual-level physical privilege exploits abstraction by pairing dense drafts with abstract drafts, establishing an intermediate physical information bottleneck to bridge the privilege gap and prevent appearance shortcuts;
♠ controlled physical variation exploits controllability by altering specific physical parameters across paired scenes with shared rollout noise, explicitly supervising how physical shifts dictate dynamic outcomes.
By internalizing structured code privilege through on-policy self-distillation, PhysOPSD empowers base video generators to generate more physically plausible dynamics and stable interactions directly from text prompts.
blocks.zh:
PhysOPSD然后系统化地将这两个属性翻译为OPSD:
双层物理特权通过将密集的草稿与抽象草稿配对,建立中间物理信息瓶颈,以弥补特权差距并防止出现捷径来利用抽象;
受控的物理变异利用了可控性,在对齐的场景中用共同的推出噪音改变具体的物理参数,明确监督物理变化如何决定动态结果。
通过内部化结构化的代码特权,通过政策上的自我消化,PhysOPSD授权基础视频生成器直接从文本提示中产生更实际可行的动态和稳定的交互.

blocks.en: To summarize, this work contributes threefold: • We propose code as privileged physical context for video generation, and introduce PhysOPSD , an on-policy self-distillation framework incorporating dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap and controlled physical variation to capture causal dynamic shifts. • We develop PhysOPSD-Engine to translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable and controllable simulation programs, and construct PhysOPSD-3K , an executable physical scene dataset featuring multi-abstraction drafts and paired physical variants. • Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD consistently improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming prior SFT and RL baselines with only a small fraction of their training data, without compromising general generation quality.
blocks.zh: 简言之,这项工作有三个方面: 我们提出代码作为视频生成的特权物理环境,并引入PhysOPSD,这是一个包含双重物理特权的关于政策自我消化的框架,以弥补信息差距和控制的物理变化,从而抓住因果动态变化。 我们开发了PhysOPSD-Engine,将现实世界的物理情景转化为可核查和可控制的模拟程序,并构建PhysOPSD-3K,这是一个可执行的物理场景数据集,以多缩写草稿和配对物理变体为主. · 广泛的实验表明,物理学OPSD不断提高不同骨干体的物理可信性,比以往的SFT和RL基线要好,其培训数据只占一小部分,但不损害一般生成质量。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation (OPD) mitigates train-test distribution shifts by supervising the student directly on its self-generated states with dense feedback [ 22 , 34 ] .
This paradigm has been applied to consolidate domain experts in language models such as MOPD [ 27 ] , fuse visual capabilities in diffusion and flow models [ 20 , 7 ] , and optimize sampling trajectories in video generation [ 9 ] .
To eliminate the reliance on external teachers, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) constructs a stronger self-teacher from the same model under asymmetric privileged information [ 50 ] .
While ground-truth solutions and rationales serve as privileged context in language reasoning [ 50 , 31 , 47 ] , D-OPSD [ 13 ] employs target-image multimodal representations to tune few-step image diffusion models.
For video models, OPSD-V [ 26 ] replaces older KV-cache history with real video frames to mitigate long-horizon drift in few-step autoregressive (AR) generators.
Unlike OPSD-V, which focuses on causal AR cache stabilization, PhysOPSD explores on-policy self-distillation for general video generation, introducing executable code as privileged physical context.
blocks.zh:
政策蒸馏(OPD)通过直接监督学生在自产生状态上使用密集的反馈[22,34]来缓解列车测试分配的转变.
这个范式被用于整合语言模型中的域专家,如MOPD[27],在扩散和流模型中的引信视觉能力[20,7],在视频生成中优化采样轨迹[9].
为了消除对外部教师的依赖,在不对称特权信息下,基于政策的自我消化(OPSD)从同一个模式中构建了更强大的自我教师[50].
虽然在语言推理[50、31、47] 中,地面真实解决方案和理由可作为特殊背景,但D-OPSD[13] 使用目标图像的多式联运表示来调和几步图像传播模式。
对于视频模型,OPSD-V [26]用真实的视频帧取代更古老的KV-cache历史,以在几步自递式(AR)发电机中减轻长视距漂移.
与侧重于因果AR缓存稳定化的OPSD-V不同的是,PhysOPSD为一般视频生成探索了政策上的自我沉淀,引入可执行代码作为特权物理上下文.

blocks.en:
Empowered by modern foundational vision-language models (VLMs) [ 33 , 37 ] , executable code is increasingly utilized for visual scene synthesis and understanding.
Early efforts such as 3D-GPT [ 35 ] synthesize Blender scripts to procedurally build 3D environments [ 16 ] .
Recent studies further leverage coding agents for programmatic visual reconstruction, editing, and quantitative physical reasoning [ 48 , 21 , 36 , 41 ] .
More recently, researchers have explored coding agents to assist visual generation by delegating spatiotemporal processes to code execution [ 6 ] , either as physics-aware drafts in Blender [ 19 ] or cinematic previsualizations in Three.js [ 23 ] .
While existing generative approaches largely seek to replace part of generative modeling with coding agent capabilities, PhysOPSD explores how executable code can empower the generative model itself.
blocks.zh:
由现代基本视觉语言模型(VLMs)[33,37]赋予力量,可执行代码越来越多地用于视觉场景合成和理解.
早期努力,例如3D-GPT[35]合成 Blender 脚本在程序上构建3D环境 [16].
最近的研究进一步利用编码剂进行方案视觉重建、编辑和定量物理推理[48、21、36、41]。
最近,研究人员探索了编码剂,通过将spatiental进程委托给编码执行[6],作为Blender [19] 的物理意识草案或3.js [23]的电影预视化,协助视觉生成.
虽然现有的基因模型方法主要寻求用编码剂能力取代部分基因模型,但PhysOPSD探索了可执行的代码如何能够增强基因模型本身的能力.

blocks.en:
OPSD relies on privileged context that reliably improves self-teacher predictions along student rollout states.
In modeling physical dynamics, however, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts remain inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos merely capture entangled visual observations.

OPSD依赖于在学生推出状态下可靠地改进自我教师预测的特权背景.
然而,在模拟物理动态方面,传统模式还很短:文字提示仍然具有内在的宣示性,而真正的参考视频仅仅捕捉缠绕的视觉观察.

blocks.en:
PhysOPSD bridges this gap by introducing executable code as privileged physical context, as shown in Figure 3 .
Unlike static text or video observations, an executable program explicitly specifies physical laws, object states, and dynamic parameters within an editable simulation, thereby uniquely providing explicit parametric control.

blocks.en: 4.2 Executable Physical Context Engine
blocks.zh: 4.2 可执行物理上下文引擎

blocks.en: To systematically synthesize verifiable and controllable privileged physical context, we develop PhysOPSD-Engine , an agentic pipeline that translates real-world physical references into executable scene programs and rendered physical drafts.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地综合可核查和可控制的特权物理环境,我们开发了PhysOPSD-Engine(英语:PhysOPSD-Engine),这个代理管道将现实世界的物理参考转化为可执行的场景程序,并制作物理草稿.

blocks.en:
To seed simulations with natural diversity, PhysOPSD-Engine ingests real-world physical scenarios from WISA [ 42 ] and public video collections.
Rather than attempting to simulate arbitrary physical phenomena, the physical scope is deliberately restricted to simulation-groundable physical dynamics , categorized into three domains: (I) rigid-body and contact dynamics, (II) elastic and deformable solid mechanics, and (III) fluid dynamics.
Phenomena such as turbulent gas diffusion or thermodynamic phase shifts are excluded due to numerical instability and the difficulty of isolating causal physical parameters in standard simulators.
blocks.zh:
为了与自然多样性进行种子模拟,PhysOPSD-Engine从WISA[42]和公开的视频收藏中摄入现实世界的物理情景.
物理范围不是试图模拟任意的物理现象,而是被故意限制在可模拟的可测物理动力上,分为三个领域:(一) 刚体和接触动力学;(二) 弹性和可变形固体力学;(三) 流体动力学。
由于数值不稳定以及标准模拟器中因果物理参数难以分离,诸如动荡气体扩散或热力学相变等现象被排除在外。

blocks.en:
Given a reference video 𝐕 ref \mathbf{V}^{\mathrm{ref}} , a coding agent 𝒜 \mathcal{A} then extracts the dominant physical event and formulates a structured physical scene specification: 𝒮 = ( 𝒪 , 𝒳 0 , 𝚽 , ℰ , 𝒞 ) , \mathcal{S}=(\mathcal{O},\mathcal{X}_{0},\bm{\Phi},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{C}), (6) where 𝒪 \mathcal{O} defines object geometries, 𝒳 0 \mathcal{X}_{0} specifies initial kinetic states, 𝚽 \bm{\Phi} collects physical properties ( e.g . , friction, elasticity, mass), ℰ \mathcal{E} indicates interaction mechanisms, and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} configures the camera trajectory.
The coding agent then compiles 𝒮 \mathcal{S} into an executable simulation program 𝒫 = 𝒜 ⁡ ( 𝒮 ) \mathcal{P}=\mathcal{A}(\mathcal{S}) .
Standard simulation backends such as MuJoCo [ 39 ] , Genesis [ 38 ] , and Blender [ 4 ] are employed purely for their deterministic contact solvers and numerical stability, without asserting the superiority of any specific engine.
Crucially, the governing principle is to reconstruct the physical scenario rather than visually reproduce the reference video : geometries and textures are simplified as long as the underlying physical mechanics are faithfully instantiated.

blocks.en: We apply PhysOPSD to two unified video generators, OmniWeaving [ 30 ] and UniVideo [ 43 ] . As a post-training method, our primary comparisons are against the respective base models to directly measure capability gains. Since prior physics-oriented post-training methods are built on disparate backbones, we additionally implement three representative baselines: PhyT2V [ 45 ] for test-time scaling, SFT using WISA [ 42 ] , and PhysHPO [ 5 ] for offline RL. We also report results from advanced video generators for reference, while further examining OPSD variants in our ablation studies. Details of baselines are in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
To answer RQ1 , we conduct comprehensive evaluations of PhysOPSD on physical and general generation benchmarks in Table 1 , complemented by qualitative baseline comparisons ( Figures 14 and 15 ) and diverse generative showcases ( Figures 5 , 16 and 17 ).
Observations are summarized below:

意见概述如下:

blocks.en:
Obs.❶ PhysOPSD consistently improves physical plausibility across backbones with high sample efficiency, while preserving general video quality. As shown in Table 1 , PhysOPSD achieves top physical adherence across both UniVideo (13B) and OmniWeaving (8.3B), boosting VideoPhy-2 overall scores by + 4.2 +4.2 and + 4.1 +4.1 , and PhyGround by + 1.6 +1.6 and + 3.4 +3.4 , respectively, with physical commonsense (PC) reaching 4.61 4.61 .
Crucially, PhysOPSD achieves these gains using only 3 3 K samples, markedly outperforming SFT ( 80 80 K) and offline RL ( 21 21 K).
Meanwhile, this physical specialization incurs no catastrophic forgetting: VBench confirms that PhysOPSD maintains or even slightly improves overall visual quality and text alignment ( e.g . , UniVideo rises from 83.5 83.5 to 84.0 84.0 , while OmniWeaving remains steady at 83.3 83.3 ), verifying that on-policy distillation protects foundational visual representations.
blocks.zh:
Obs.❶ PhysOPSD在保持一般视频质量的同时,不断提高跨骨干体质的可信度,具有较高的样本效率. 如表1所示,PhysOPSD在UniVideo(13B)和OmniWeaving(8.3B)上都实现了最高物理坚持度,将VideoPhy-2整体分数分别提升为+4.2+4.2和+4.1+4.1,PhyGround分别提升为+1.6+1.6和+3.4+3.4,物理常识(PC)达到4.614.61.
关键的是,PhysOPSD只利用3个3K个样本,显著优于SFT(80 80 K)和离线RL(21 21 K)来取得这些收益.
同时,这种物理专门化不会造成灾难性的遗忘:V Bench确认PhysOPSD保持甚至略微改善整体视觉质量和文本对齐(例如,UniVideo从83.5 83.5上升到84.0 84.0,OmniWeaving则稳定在83.3 83.3),验证政策上的蒸馏保护了基础视觉表现.

blocks.en:
Obs.❷ PhysOPSD generates physically faithful dynamics over baselines and generalizes robustly to visually rich, open-domain scenes. In Figures 14 and 15 , baselines exhibit motion stagnation, severe geometric distortions, or broken reflection mechanics during concrete leveling and teapot rotation, whereas PhysOPSD synthesizes continuous, physically consistent interactions.
Furthermore, although physical drafts in PhysOPSD-Engine use simplified simulation geometry, the learned dynamics transfer robustly to open-domain photorealistic scenes ( Figures 5 , 16 and 17 ), successfully capturing fluid sloshing, impact cratering, elastic penetration, and optical reflection.
This verifies that PhysOPSD internalizes transferable physical mechanics rather than overfitting to synthetic simulation appearances.
blocks.zh:
Obs.❷ PhysOPSD在基线上产生物理上忠实的动态,并强力地概括到视觉上丰富,开放的场景. 在图14和图15中,基线显示运动停滞、严重的几何扭曲或混凝土平整和茶壶旋转过程中的反射力学断裂,而PhysOPSD则合成连续的、物理上一致的相互作用。
此外,虽然物理草案在PhysOPSD-Engine中使用了简化的模拟几何学,但所学的动态学将强烈地转移到了开放域的光现实主义场景(图5、16和17),成功地捕捉了流体的溅射、撞击坑、弹性渗透和光学反射。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present PhysOPSD , a post-training framework that introduces executable code as privileged physical context for on-policy self-distillation.
Recognizing that executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability, we develop PhysOPSD-Engine to construct verifiable simulation scenes and rendered drafts. PhysOPSD systematically translates these properties into dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose dynamic causality.
Extensive experiments on standard physics benchmarks demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones with high sample efficiency, while preserving general video quality.
We hope our code-as-privilege inspires future research on leveraging coding agents to empower generative models rather than replacing them, advancing physically grounded visual generation.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们介绍了PhysOPSD,这是一个培训后框架,将可执行守则作为政策自我消化的特权实际环境。
认识到可执行代码即时化了一个具有内在抽象和可控性的可编辑物理世界,我们开发了PhysOPSD-Engine来构建可核查的模拟场景,并提供了草稿. PhysOPSD系统化地将这些特性转化为通过中间瓶颈来弥补信息差距的双层物理特权,同时在共享推出噪声下进行受控的物理变异以暴露动态因果关系.
对标准物理基准的广泛实验表明,物理学OPSD在保持一般视频质量的同时,大大改进了各种骨干之间的物理可信度,具有很高的样本效率.
我们希望,我们的代码优先激励未来的研究,即利用编码剂增强基因模型的能力,而不是取代这些模型,推动基于身体的视觉生成。

blocks.en: 7 Scope of This Report
blocks.zh: 7 本报告的范围

blocks.en:
PhysOPSD contributes a general on-policy self-distillation framework rather than delivering a single weight-locked model.
This motivates our focus on relative capability gains over respective base generators ( e.g . , UniVideo [ 43 ] and OmniWeaving [ 30 ] ) to confirm cross-architecture generalizability.
Furthermore, our compact default budget of 3 3 K samples highlights sample efficiency, while our scaling analysis ( Section 5.5 ) confirms steady performance gains as data increases.
blocks.zh:
PhysOPSD提供了一个关于政策的一般自我消化框架,而不是提供单一的权重限制模型。
这促使我们注重相对提高各自基发电机的能力(例如UniVideo[43]和OmniWeaving[30]),以确认跨结构的通用性。
此外,我们3 3 K个样本的紧凑缺省预算突出了样本效率,而我们的缩放分析(第5.5节)证实,随着数据的增加,业绩稳步提高。

blocks.en:
Central to our philosophy is leveraging coding agents to empower generative models rather than substituting them at test time. PhysOPSD-Engine is thus designed as an open, modular pipeline interfacing standard coding LLMs with physics engines.
As foundational coding agents and physics solvers advance, the pipeline naturally inherits the ability to synthesize increasingly complex physical scenarios without altering the distillation formulation.
blocks.zh:
我们哲学的核心是利用编码剂增强基因模型的能力,而不是在试验时取代它们。 PhysOPSD-Engine因此被设计为一种开放的,模块化的管道接口标准编码LLMs与物理引擎.
随着基础编码剂和物理解析器的推进,管道自然继承了在不改变蒸馏配体的情况下合成日益复杂的物理情景的能力.

blocks.en:
The physical scope of PhysOPSD is bounded by scenarios that standard simulation engines can stably compute: rigid-body contacts, elastic mechanics, and fluid dynamics.
Chaotic multi-physics and thermodynamic phase transitions ( e.g . , combustion) are deliberately excluded due to solver instability and difficulty in isolating parameters.
Rather than emulating all physical phenomena, our objective is establishing a principled blueprint for internalizing physical dynamics via code privilege.
blocks.zh:
PhysOPSD的物理范围以标准模拟引擎可以稳定计算的各种情景为界:刚性-体接触,弹性力学,和流体动力学.
Chaotic多物理和热力学相过渡(如燃烧)由于解体不稳定和隔离参数困难而被故意排除.
我们的目标不是模仿所有物理现象,而是为通过密码特权使物理动态内部化制定一个原则性蓝图。

blocks.en: A.1 PhysOPSD-Engine Details
blocks.zh: A.1 物理OPSD-工程细节

blocks.en:
Synthesizing executable physical scenes requires translating abstract dynamic descriptions into syntactically valid and numerically stable simulation code.
While frontier LLMs/VLMs exhibit proficient code generation and spatial reasoning, the non-linear nature of contact dynamics makes single-pass zero-shot generation unreliable for complex physical phenomena.
To guarantee a verifiable physical basis, PhysOPSD-Engine combines a frontier coding agent with an automated execution-guided refinement loop.
blocks.zh:
合成可执行物理场景需要将抽象的动态描述翻译为在战术上有效和数字上稳定的模拟码.
虽然边疆LLM/VLMs展现了熟练的代码生成和空间推理,但接触动力学的非线性性质使得单传零镜头生成对于复杂的物理现象是不可靠的.
为了保证可核查的物理基础,PhysOPSD-Engine将边框编码剂与自动执行制导的完善环结合.

blocks.en:
We adopt GPT-6-Astra as the backbone coding agent.
Upon generating an initial scene program 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , PhysOPSD-Engine executes it in the target backend ( e.g . , MuJoCo [ 39 ] or Blender [ 4 ] ) and aggregates diagnostic feedback across three modalities: ❶ execution logs ( e.g . , syntax errors or solver convergence warnings), ❷ kinematic telemetry ( e.g . , penetration anomalies or constraint forces), and ❸ rendered preview keyframes.
When physical implausibility, solver divergence, or poor camera observability is detected, the coding agent inspects the diagnostic trace to revise geometric configurations, contact parameters, or camera trajectories.
This execution-observation-revision cycle iterates until all four verification criteria in Section 4.2 are satisfied.
blocks.zh:
我们采用GPT-6-Astra作为主干编码代理.
生成初始场景程序P\mathcal{P}后,PhysOPSD-Engine在目标后端执行(例如,MujoCo[39]或Blender[4]),并汇总了三种模式的诊断反馈:QQ执行日志(例如,语法错误或解析器趋同警告),QQ运动遥测(例如,穿透异常或约束力),QQQ提供了预览密钥框架.
当检测到物理不可信,解析器偏差,或相机可观察性差时,编码剂检查诊断痕量,以修正几何配置,接触参数,或相机轨迹.
这一执行-观察-修订周期一直持续到第4.2节的所有四项核查标准都达到为止。

blocks.en:
To prevent dynamic discrepancies across privilege levels, dense drafts 𝐝 dense \mathbf{d}^{\mathrm{dense}} and abstract drafts 𝐝 abs \mathbf{d}^{\mathrm{abs}} for a given variant are rendered from an identical, frozen simulation state trajectory .
Specifically, once a simulation execution succeeds, PhysOPSD-Engine records the full kinematic trajectory of all bodies and contact events. 𝐝 dense \mathbf{d}^{\mathrm{dense}} is rendered with full surface meshes, material shaders, and realistic lighting, whereas 𝐝 abs \mathbf{d}^{\mathrm{abs}} renders simplified wireframe primitives and centroid trajectories from the exact same camera viewpoint.
This trajectory freezing guarantees that both privilege levels share identical underlying dynamics, completely eliminating confounding dynamic drift caused by re-simulation.
For controlled variants, non-target attributes and initial conditions are frozen to isolate the causal parameter shift.
blocks.zh:
为防止在特权级别之间出现动态差异,对特定变体来说,密集的草稿 d commathbf{ d}^{\ mathrm{ dense} 和抽象的草稿 dabs\ mathbf{ d}^{\ mathrm{abs} 由相同的,冻结的模拟状态轨迹提供 。
具体来说,一旦模拟执行成功,PhysOPSD-Engine记录了所有身体的全部运动轨迹和接触事件. d 稠密的 \ mathbf{ d}^{\ mathrm{ dense} 用完整的表面膜、 材料遮蔽器和现实的照明来制成, 而 d abs\ mathbf{ d}^{\ mathrm{ abs} 则使得简化的线框和中间行星轨迹从完全相同的相机角度出发是原始的。
这种轨迹冻结保证了两种特权级别都具有相同的基本动力,完全消除了重模拟引起的混乱的动态漂移.
对于受控变体,非目标属性和初始条件被冻结,以隔离因果参数转移.

In the main text, we denote the target text condition uniformly as 𝐩 \mathbf{p} for mathematical clarity.
In practice, accommodating our omni-capable video generator entails producing two complementary text conditions via Qwen3-VL-32B [ 46 ] , conditioned on the dense draft alongside a structured fact card containing measured physical telemetry: • T2V Prompt : a self-contained description detailing the scene context, physical conditions, observable dynamic trajectory, and final state, used for deployment-time text-only student generation. • V2V Instruction : an imperative prompt instructing the model to perform photorealistic visual refinement while strictly preserving the underlying spatiotemporal dynamics and spatial layout, shared by the teacher and draft-conditioned student. Both text modalities are grounded strictly in the executed simulation telemetry rather than speculative prior descriptions.
The concrete system prompts utilized for annotation are detailed below.

blocks.en:
To further validate the necessity of our agentic execution-guided loop, we compare PhysOPSD-Engine against a standard harness framework ( i.e . , Codex) using the identical backbone coding model (GPT-6-Astra).
As illustrated in Figure 9 , naive code generation without closed-loop simulation feedback frequently degenerates into non-physical shortcuts:
collapsing into 2D schematic toy drawings without fluid mechanics ( e.g . , fluid pouring), omitting structural apparatus and floating in an ungrounded void ( e.g . , sponge compression), or approximating continuous 3D dynamics with simplistic line segments ( e.g . , transverse spring waves).
In contrast, PhysOPSD-Engine leverages multi-modal execution diagnostics and kinematic telemetry to iteratively refine boundary conditions, contact constraints, and spatial geometry.
This closed-loop refinement guarantees that the synthesized programs instantiate verifiable 3D physical environments with observable, physically grounded dynamics.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步验证我们代理执行制导环路的必要性,我们用相同的主干编码模型(GPT-6-Astra),将PhysOPSD-Engine与标准牵引框架(即Codex)进行比较.
如图9所示,没有闭路模拟反馈的天真代码生成经常退化成非物理快捷方式:
崩溃成没有流体力学(如流体倾注)的2D示意图玩具图,省略结构器和漂浮在无底空(如海绵压缩)中,或者用简单线段(如横跨的弹簧波)来近似连续的3D动力学.
相比之下,PhysOPSD-Engine利用多式执行诊断和动能遥测来迭代完善边界条件,接触限制和空间几何.
这种闭路改进保证了被合成的程序即时地将可核查的三维物理环境与可观测的,物理上基础的动力学结合.

blocks.en:
As a post-training framework, our primary evaluation focuses on assessing relative capability gains against the respective base models.
Furthermore, because physics-oriented post-training methods for video generation remain relatively scarce and are typically coupled with disparate backbones, we select and adapt three baselines to represent three prevailing post-training paradigms onto the same backbones: • PhyT2V [ 45 ] : an iterative test-time refinement strategy. We preserve its physical chain-of-thought reasoning and prompt revision workflow, adapting its generator to our respective base models for direct paradigm comparison. • SFT [ 42 ] : standard supervised fine-tuning on physics-specific demonstrations. We fine-tune each base model on WISA-80K, which comprises approximately 80 80 K curated text-video pairs spanning 17 physical categories across dynamics, thermodynamics, and optics. • PhysHPO [ 5 ] : an offline hierarchical preference optimization framework. We adopt its original 21 21 K curated real-world videos from OpenVidHD [ 29 ] as positive demonstrations, paired with base model rollouts as negative samples, tailored to OmniWeaving and UniVideo.

blocks.en:
VideoPhy-2 [ 3 ] evaluates action-centric physical commonsense across 200 action categories under the T2V setting.
Following [ 42 ] , we assess Semantic Adherence (SA) and Physical Commonsense (PC) by using GPT-5.5, reporting mean scores, the proportions of videos achieving SA ≥ 4 \text{SA}\geq 4 and PC ≥ 4 \text{PC}\geq 4 , and the joint metric (All) satisfying both criteria simultaneously.

blocks.en:
PhyGround [ 24 ] benchmarks text- and initial-frame-conditioned generation (TI2V) across 250 diverse scenarios spanning 13 physical laws in solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, and optics.
Following its official benchmark protocol, we evaluate General plausibility (covering temporal coherence and object permanence) and law-specific Physics compliance, reporting their equal-weighted Overall score.

We employ VBench 1.0 [ 11 ] to benchmark general video generation capabilities under the T2V protocol.
Following the official evaluation suite across 16 fine-grained dimensions, we report normalized Quality, Semantic, and Total scores using standard prompt sets.
